info.name: vici-sensei-app
info.description:
API tests for the vici-sensei-app Japanese SRS backend (Next.js route handlers + Supabase/PostgreSQL).

Auth model: routes read the Supabase session from a `sb-<project-ref>-auth-token` cookie (via @supabase/ssr, HttpOnly, sometimes split into `.0`/`.1` chunks). There is no bearer-token support in this app.

Cookies are supplied via the Postman Interceptor browser extension, NOT a manual header - no request in this collection sets a `Cookie` header itself, so nothing here overrides what the Interceptor-synced Cookie Jar sends automatically.

Setup (one-time):
1. Install the 'Postman Interceptor' extension in Chrome (Chrome Web Store) and make sure it's enabled/active.
2. In Postman Desktop: Settings (gear icon) > General > enable the Interceptor connection - it should show as connected once the Chrome extension is active.
3. Open any request here, click 'Cookies' near the top of the request builder, and make sure cookie syncing is on for `localhost` (the domain the app runs on).
4. Log into the app normally at http://localhost:3000 in that same Chrome window - Postman's Cookie Jar for `localhost` picks up the `sb-...-auth-token` cookie(s) automatically, including the HttpOnly ones, with no copy-pasting.
5. Run 'Health check' first to confirm the dev server + DB are reachable before running anything else.

If Interceptor ever stops syncing (extension disabled, cookie jar cleared), the fallback is to grab the cookie from DevTools > Application > Cookies once and paste it as a request-level `Cookie` header just for that troubleshooting session - do not restore it collection-wide, since a hardcoded header will silently stop reflecting future logins/session refreshes.

Most folders are safe to run repeatedly. The exceptions are called out in request descriptions: introduce-kanji/introduce-vocabulary will 409 on a second run (by design), and 'Delete own account' in Auth/User is destructive and irreversible - do not include it in a collection-wide Runner pass.

item.name: 0. Auth Helper
item.description: This app only trusts the Supabase session cookie set by @supabase/ssr - it does not accept an Authorization: Bearer header. Auth for every other request in this collection is handled by the Postman Interceptor-synced Cookie Jar (see the collection description) once you log into the app in Chrome. The request below is optional: it hits Supabase's GoTrue REST API directly to obtain a fresh access/refresh token pair for inspection/debugging only - it does not feed into the Cookie Jar or any other request.

item.name: Get fresh access/refresh tokens (Supabase password grant)

exec: console.log('access_token / refresh_token retrieved. Building the sb-...-auth-token cookie value from these is version-specific for @supabase/ssr - the reliable path is still to copy the cookie from your browser session and paste it into the authCookie variable.');

item.name: Webhook - 400 missing signature (cannot fully test from Postman)

request.description: Stripe signs every real webhook body with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; Postman cannot produce that signature, so this route can only be exercised end-to-end via `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/stripe/webhook` + `stripe trigger <event>`. This request only verifies the 'missing signature' guard clause.
